description: This file defines several mixins related to caret icons/indicators, including directions and positioning, for styling components in SCSS.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Mixin for creating a downward pointing caret using borders.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Mixin for creating an upward pointing caret.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Mixin for creating a caret pointing to the end (right).

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Mixin for creating a caret pointing to the start (left).

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Main mixin that combines directional caret styles with optional spacing and alignment.
